The '''Separatist probe droid''' was a model of [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Recon_droid_walk.png|thumb|left|220px|A recon droid walking on its appendages]]
These [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were roughly the size of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] torso and consisted of a central body with a number of small [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] hanging from the underside. They floated across their environment allowing them a great degree of mobility and were small enough to remain somewhat hidden from enemies.<ref name="Defenders of Peace" /> The aforementioned limbs could be used to grasp onto surfaces such as roof tops.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth">{{TCW|Innocents of Ryloth}}</ref>

==History==
At least one Separatist probe droid was deployed onto the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]] by forces under [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]]. This droid discovered the presence of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on the planet whereupon it was located by [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. The droid attempted to flee and warn the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] but its communications were being jammed by the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] and it was ultimately destroyed by [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]].<ref name="Defenders of Peace" />

At least three of these units were deployed on the Separatist-controlled planet of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]]<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /><ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref> by [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|Tactical droids]] [[TX-20/Legends|TX-20]]<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> and [[TA-175/Legends|TA-175]],<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> in order to spy on [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> and their troops.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /><ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> Recon droids were also present guarding the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]] on [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]].<ref name="Counterattack" />

Two recon droids were used during the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Skirmish on Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. They pursued [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] while he was chasing Separatist [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Rish Loo/Legends|Rish Loo]]. These recon droids were equipped with blaster cannons.<ref name="Shadow Warrior">{{TCW|Shadow Warrior}}</ref>

===Serenno flying droid===
Droids using the same chassis were used in the [[Box/Legends|Box]] on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. The droids' legs were replaced with four blasters and their visual sensors were modified to glow red. They attacked [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]]&mdash;[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in disguise&mdash;while he fought [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]].<ref name="The Box">{{TCW|The Box}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
According to concept art published on [[StarWars.com]], the "Serenno Flying Droid's" rendering was sourced from the Separatist probe droid. This statement does not indicate whether, in canon, this droid was a modified recon droid or a new droid entirely.
